home.hero_title: Two towers, one bridge. Quiet luxury in the heart of Cali.
home.hero_sub: A contemporary sanctuary where the serenity of the Cali River, haute cuisine, and warm Valle hospitality converge.
home.intro_text: Located in the historic El Peñón district, Hotel Dann Carlton Cali pairs five-star heritage with timeless contemporary design. Two towers linked by an exclusive private pedestrian bridge offer an unmatched setting for both business and leisure.
home.rooms_desc: 186 soundproofed rooms and suites offering sweeping vistas of the skyline and the Farallones mountains.
home.dining_desc: From al fresco dining beside the pool at Las Palmas to evening handcrafted cocktails at Bahía Carlton Lobby Bar.
home.offers_desc: Celebrate unforgettable milestones with our bespoke romantic packages and wellness retreats.
home.location_title: The bohemian elegance of El Peñón
home.location_desc: Steps away from art galleries, signature restaurants, and the riverbank promenade, with seamless connections to the financial core and airport.

rooms_page.hero_sub: Conceived with authentic materials, calming earth tones, and expansive city vistas.

amenities_page.hero_sub: Balance, rejuvenation, and attentive hospitality throughout your stay.

dining_page.hero_sub: Sophisticated culinary craftsmanship celebrating local heirloom produce and Colombian Pacific heritage.

spa_page.hero_sub: Holistic rituals, 60-minute botanical facials, and therapeutic body treatments to restore vitality.
